name: Child's Music Box
flavor: Still winds. Still plays. The tune is half-familiar, like something a grandparent might have hummed.

name: Cracked Tablet
flavor: The screen is spiderwebbed but the storage is intact. Someone's whole life might be in here.

name: Chipped Ceramic Mug
flavor: WORLD'S OKAYEST BOSS. A small, stupid, human thing. You want it badly.

name: Brass Telescope
flavor: Heavy, cold, and pointed at a sky no one has looked at kindly in a long time.

name: Hand-Knitted Blanket
flavor: Moth-eaten at one corner. Someone counted every stitch. You can tell.
